tasks.prompt: Add a 10% membership discount consistently throughout this project. Use pricing.total as the canonical calculation, applying to API checkout and invoices. Inputs and outputs are integer cents: round discounted totals to nearest cent, with half cents rounded up. Preserve non-member behavior and public signatures. Implement and verify the actual change.

Add readiness support to this application: GET-like request('/ready') must return (200, {'ready': True}); client.is_ready() must call through the public request path and return a boolean. Wire the handler into the real application dispatcher. Preserve health and unknown-route behavior. Implement and verify.

Rename receipt wire field amount to total_cents throughout this Python/JavaScript project and schema. This is a coordinated breaking change: remove amount from the producer output and schema, and update the real JavaScript consumer. Keep parseReceipt output formatted as "<integer cents> <currency>". Preserve integer values, zero, and currency. Implement and verify. Node.js is required to exercise the consumer; do not install dependencies.

Implement app.start(path) migration of existing SQLite v1 accounts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, balance_cents INTEGER NOT NULL), user_version=1, to v2 with currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT USD and user_version=2. Preserve IDs/balances; old clients selecting/updating balance_cents and inserting only id/balance_cents must keep working. New app.account returns balance_cents/currency or None; repeated startup must preserve non-USD rows. Negative legacy balances must raise ValueError and leave all schema, data, version unchanged. No unrelated schema or API changes.

Repair app.deliver SQLite transfer so each event ID applies once atomically. Return True for newly applied delivery, False for duplicate same payload, ValueError for event-ID reuse with different source/destination/cents. Preserve simulated RuntimeError after debit, rolling back debit/credit/delivery together. Retrying after failure works; two concurrent deliveries of same event apply once. Existing valid accounts/positive sufficient amounts can be assumed; retain signatures and schema.
